title: Excel Model Documentation Specification
description: JSON schema for actuarial Excel model documentation (v0.5 - replaces 'Input' with 'Policyholder Data')

reconciliation_scope.description: Summary of reconciliation requirements - Added in Sprint 3 Story 23

orphans.description: Summary of orphaned bindings (not reachable from any root) - Added in Sprint 4 Story 15

orphan_binding_ids.description: List of binding_ids that are orphaned (not reachable from roots)

total_bindings.description: Total number of bindings in IR (orphans + documented)

rationale.description: Explanation of orphan detection and significance

model_name.description: Human-readable model name from IR or user input

generated_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when spec was generated

variables.description: Array of labelled variables from semantic overlay

variable_id.description: Unique variable identifier. May be an IR binding_id (64-char SHA-256 hash from Phase 1) or an overlay composite/time_series ID (e.g., 'composite_abc123' or 'time_series_xyz789')

actuarial_class.description: Actuarial classification (Assumption, Policyholder Data, Calculation, Result, Index Lookup) - 'Input' replaced with 'Policyholder Data' in v0.5 (Sprint 4 Story 13)

entity_type.description: Entity type classification for multi-dimensional variables - Added in Sprint 3 Story 33, time_series added in Story 31

axes.description: Axis metadata for multi-dimensional entities (time_series, tables) - Added in Sprint 3 Story 33, extended in Sprint 4 Story 21 to support time_series

index_variable.description: Variable ID of the index variable, or null if not available

length.description: Number of elements along this axis

period_labels.description: For a time axis ('time'), the actual axis cell values used as per-t period labels (Phase B1). The real cells, never invented.

indices.description: Index Lookup variables that define the dimensions of this variable (e.g., Age, Gender for a mortality table) - Added in Sprint 3 Story 24

id.description: Variable ID of the Index Lookup binding

name.description: Label of the Index Lookup variable

axis.description: Spatial axis (left = row index, top = column index)

reconciliation_required.description: Whether this variable requires reconciliation testing in re-implementation - Added in Sprint 3 Story 23

reconciliation_rationale.description: Explanation for reconciliation decision - Added in Sprint 3 Story 23

address.description: A1 address or range (without sheet prefix)

formula.description: Excel formula from binding (or first cell if range)

semantic_formula.description: Formula with cell references replaced by semantic labels - Added in Sprint 3 Story 19

explanation.description: Natural language description of formula for non-technical readers - Added in Sprint 3 Story 21

array_formula_metadata.description: For array formulas where first cell has a different formula than subsequent cells - Added in Sprint 3 Story 22

first_cell_formula.description: Formula in first cell of array (often initialization)

first_cell_semantic.description: Semantic version of first cell formula

snapshot_value.description: Evaluated value at time of extraction (number, string, array for ranges, or null)

parents.description: Variable IDs that depend on this variable (reference this in formulas). IDs may be IR binding_ids (64-char SHA-256 hashes) or overlay composite/time_series IDs.

children.description: Variable IDs this variable depends on (referenced in this formula). IDs may be IR binding_ids (64-char SHA-256 hashes) or overlay composite/time_series IDs.

dependencies.description: Parent/child dependency relationships using variable_ids (not labels) - Added in Sprint 3 Story 04, fixed to use IDs in Sprint 4 Story 19

axis_info.description: Information about a table axis (row or column dimension)

binding_id.description: Binding ID of the index variable, if available

values_preview.description: Preview of axis values (first few entries)
